title: Our Clients
text:
Our Clients
Euronext Securities Porto provides a wide range of services to Issuers with securities registered in our centralised system and to Financial Intermediaries affiliated with our managed systems.
Euronext Securities Porto also provides services to other entities that, in accordance with the current legislation and regulations, can acquire Participant status in our systems.
